notes: QA checked all fields vs live Content API 2026-11-09; user spot-checked fee lines
Fee rule (#59): the standard (up to 6 months) Standard Visitor visa is £135. Long-term (2/5/10 year), medical and academic variants and the £1,172 in-UK extension are excluded. No IHS for visitors.
isExtendable: true — a stay under 6 months can be extended up to a total of 6 months (and longer for medical treatment / academics).
Processing time (user decision, 2026-11-09): FULL RANGE: min = outside-UK visa decision (3 weeks), max = inside-UK extension decision, standard service (8 weeks).

documentKinds (#187) scores 14 items: the passport / travel document sentence (document, required) plus the 13 items of the page's two lists ('information in your online application' = required unless an inline 'if'; 'Depending on your circumstances' = conditional). Only the passport and the TB certificate are documents; every other item is information. The extractor lists the passport sentence as an item, so it is scored.

answerTypes (#187 regroom): the 12 information items carry the type their own words give: travel dates date_range; trip cost and earnings money; where you'll be staying, home address and employer's address address; parents' names and dates of birth, offences, travel history, anyone paying and family members list; partner's name, date of birth and passport number text (it asks several fields at once).

name.source: You can visit the UK as a Standard Visitor for tourism, business, study (courses up to 6 months) and other permitted activities.

category.source: You can visit the UK as a Standard Visitor for tourism, business, study (courses up to 6 months) and other permitted activities.

processingDaysMin.source: you’ll usually get a decision on your visa within 3 weeks.

processingDaysMax.source: If you use the standard service, a decision will usually be made within 8 weeks of providing your supporting documents and proving your identity.

validityPeriod.source: You can usually stay in the UK for up to 6 months.

isExtendable.source: You may be able to extend your stay if you have permission to be in the UK for less than 6 months. You can extend your stay up to a total of 6 months.

components.source: A Standard Visitor visa costs £135 for up to 6 months.

items.source: You must have a passport or travel document that is valid for the whole of your stay in the UK.
the dates you’re planning to travel to the UK
where you’ll be staying during your visit
how much you think your trip will cost
your current home address and how long you’ve lived there
your parents’ names and dates of birth (if known)
how much you earn in a year (if you have an income)
details of any criminal, civil or immigration offences you may have committed
details of your travel history for the past 10 years
your employer’s address and telephone number
your partner’s name, date of birth and passport number
the name and address of anyone paying for your trip
the name, address and passport number of any family members you have in the UK
a certificate proving that you’ve had a tuberculosis (TB) test if you’re visiting for more than 6 months
